name: @codeai-hub/kimi-module
description: Kimi provider integration for CodeAI Hub core

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node -e "const assert=require('node:assert/strict'); const fs=require('node:fs'); const os=require('node:os'); const path=require('node:path'); const kimi=require('./dist/index.js'); const {KimiWireEventNormalizer,normalizeKimiWireEvent}=require('./dist/messaging/kimi-event-normalizer.js'); const {KimiWireRouter}=require('./dist/wire/kimi-wire-router.js'); const textEvents=normalizeKimiWireEvent({type:'ContentPart',payload:{type:'text',text:'visible reply'}}); assert.equal(textEvents[0].type,'assistant'); assert.equal(textEvents[0].content,'visible reply'); const thinkingEvents=normalizeKimiWireEvent({type:'ContentPart',payload:{type:'think',think:'internal thought'}}); assert.equal(thinkingEvents[0].type,'thinking'); assert.equal(thinkingEvents[0].content,'internal thought'); assert.equal(thinkingEvents[0].tag,'thinking'); const terminalEvents=normalizeKimiWireEvent({type:'TurnEnd'}); assert.equal(terminalEvents[0].type,'turn_completed'); assert.equal(terminalEvents[0].postTurnTokenUsageUnavailable,true); const normalizer=new KimiWireEventNormalizer(); assert.deepEqual(normalizer.normalize({type:'TurnBegin'}).map((event)=>event.type),['turn_started']); assert.deepEqual(normalizer.normalize({type:'ContentPart',payload:{type:'think',think:'planning'}}),[]); const toolBoundaryEvents=normalizer.normalize({type:'ToolCall',payload:{type:'function',function:{name:'WriteFile'}}}); assert.deepEqual(toolBoundaryEvents.map((event)=>event.type),['thinking','stream_event']); assert.equal(toolBoundaryEvents[0].content,'planning'); assert.equal(toolBoundaryEvents[1].data.phase,'tool_call'); assert.equal(toolBoundaryEvents[1].data.toolName,'WriteFile'); assert.deepEqual(normalizer.normalize({type:'ContentPart',payload:{type:'text',text:'done'}}),[]); const stepBoundaryEvents=normalizer.normalize({type:'StepBegin',payload:{n:2}}); assert.deepEqual(stepBoundaryEvents.map((event)=>event.type),['assistant','step_started','stream_event']); assert.equal(stepBoundaryEvents[0].content,'done'); assert.equal(stepBoundaryEvents[2].data.phase,'step_started'); assert.equal(stepBoundaryEvents[2].data.step,2); const completionEvents=normalizer.normalize({type:'TurnEnd'}); assert.deepEqual(completionEvents.map((event)=>event.type),['turn_completed']); assert.equal(completionEvents[0].postTurnTokenUsageUnavailable,true); const streamingNormalizer=new KimiWireEventNormalizer(); streamingNormalizer.normalize({type:'TurnBegin'}); const earlyThinking='x'.repeat(900); const earlyThinkingEvents=streamingNormalizer.normalize({type:'ContentPart',payload:{type:'think',think:earlyThinking}}); assert.deepEqual(earlyThinkingEvents.map((event)=>event.type),['thinking']); assert.equal(earlyThinkingEvents[0].content,earlyThinking); assert.deepEqual(streamingNormalizer.normalize({type:'TurnEnd'}).map((event)=>event.type),['turn_completed']); const sent=[]; let malformed=null; const router=new KimiWireRouter({sendJson:(m)=>sent.push(m),onMalformedFrame:(line,error)=>{malformed={line,error};}}); const pending=router.request('initialize',{}); router.handleLine(JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:1,result:{status:'ok'}})); router.handleLine('not-json'); const tempDir=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'kimi-provider-home-')); const providerHomePath=path.join(tempDir,'providers','kimi','home'); const workspacePath=path.join(tempDir,'workspace'); const agentDir=path.join(providerHomePath,'codeai-managed-agent'); const agentFile=path.join(agentDir,'agent.yaml'); const mcpFile=path.join(agentDir,'mcp-empty.json'); const skillsDir=path.join(agentDir,'skills-empty'); fs.mkdirSync(workspacePath,{recursive:true}); let metadata=null; const adapter=new kimi.KimiProviderAdapter({workspace:{workspacePath,providerHomePath,configPath:'/tmp/user-kimi/config.toml'},reporter:{info:(_message,nextMetadata)=>{metadata=nextMetadata;}}}); assert.equal(typeof adapter.subscribe,'function'); const unsubscribe=adapter.subscribe('smoke-session',()=>{}); assert.equal(typeof unsubscribe,'function'); unsubscribe(); Promise.all([pending,adapter.initialize()]).then(([result])=>{assert.deepEqual(result,{status:'ok'}); assert.equal(malformed.line,'not-json'); assert.equal(fs.statSync(providerHomePath).isDirectory(),true); assert.equal(fs.statSync(agentFile).isFile(),true); assert.equal(fs.statSync(mcpFile).isFile(),true); assert.equal(fs.statSync(skillsDir).isDirectory(),true); assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(agentFile,'utf8').includes('kimi_cli.tools.agent:Agent'),false); assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(agentDir,'system.md'),'utf8').includes('KIMI_AGENTS_MD'),false); assert.equal(metadata.providerHomePath,providerHomePath); assert.equal(metadata.userConfigPath,'/tmp/user-kimi/config.toml'); assert.deepEqual(metadata.cliArgs,['--config-file','/tmp/user-kimi/config.toml','--agent-file',agentFile,'--mcp-config-file',mcpFile,'--skills-dir',skillsDir,'--yolo','--work-dir',workspacePath]); fs.rmSync(tempDir,{force:true,recursive:true});}).catch((error)=>{fs.rmSync(tempDir,{force:true,recursive:true}); throw error;});"
